route_thesis: Use architecture as a way to understand how Shanghai changes scale, time and public life.
why_this_route_fits: It gives a first-time visitor an orientation frame before asking for detail.
It turns architecture into questions about money, migration, public life and reuse—not just façades.
hypotheses_to_confirm: Would you rather understand one city clearly than try to cover its famous places?

commercial.upgrade_reason: The paid roadbook adds the complete day-by-day route, decision ledger, fallback branches and human review scope.

delivery_boundary: This preview is a fit-check and lead-generation artifact. It is not a complete itinerary, booking, live availability check or experience quote.
